NR-01.name: Goods Not Received (Full)
NR-01.description: Cardholder ordered physical goods and claims they never arrived. The entire order is missing.
NR-01.key_evidence: Shipping tracking, carrier delivery scan, GPS delivery coordinates, signature/photo proof, cardholder address verification
NR-01.auto_fetch_sources: Carrier tracking API (FedEx/UPS/USPS/DHL), merchant order management system, address verification service

NR-02.name: Goods Partially Received
NR-02.description: Cardholder received only some items from a multi-item order. Specific items are missing from the shipment.
NR-02.key_evidence: Packing slip vs. order manifest, shipment weight comparison, warehouse pick/pack records, split-shipment tracking
NR-02.auto_fetch_sources: Warehouse management system, multi-package tracking, order line-item data

NR-03.name: Services Not Rendered
NR-03.description: Cardholder paid for a service (consulting, repair, event, class, etc.) that was never performed or provided.
NR-03.key_evidence: Service appointment records, contractor/provider logs, check-in records, service completion confirmation
NR-03.auto_fetch_sources: Merchant booking/scheduling system, service provider records, attendance logs

NR-04.name: Digital Goods Not Delivered
NR-04.description: Cardholder paid for digital content (software, download, game, ebook, course access) but never received access or the download link.
NR-04.key_evidence: Download/access logs, email delivery records, account provisioning timestamps, IP/device login data
NR-04.auto_fetch_sources: Digital delivery platform logs, email service provider delivery status, license key generation records

NR-05.name: Late Delivery Beyond Promised Date
NR-05.description: Goods arrived but significantly after the promised delivery date, making them useless for the intended purpose (e.g., event decorations arriving after the event).
NR-05.key_evidence: Original delivery promise (order confirmation), actual delivery date, communication about delays, merchant's delivery guarantee policy
NR-05.auto_fetch_sources: Order confirmation email, carrier tracking timeline, merchant ToS on delivery guarantees

QD-01.name: Goods Damaged on Arrival
QD-01.description: Cardholder received goods that were physically damaged during shipping — dents, cracks, broken parts, water damage, etc.
QD-01.key_evidence: Photos of damaged item AND packaging, product listing images for comparison, merchant packaging standards, carrier damage claim
QD-01.auto_fetch_sources: Image analysis (CLIP + BLIP-2), product listing scraper, carrier claims API, merchant QC records

QD-02.name: Goods Defective / Not Working
QD-02.description: Item arrived intact but doesn't function as intended — electronics won't power on, software crashes, mechanical parts fail, etc.
QD-02.key_evidence: Cardholder description of defect, product specs vs. actual behavior, warranty status, manufacturer defect reports, repair attempts
QD-02.auto_fetch_sources: Product database for specs, warranty registration system, manufacturer recall/defect databases

QD-03.name: Goods Not As Described
QD-03.description: Item received differs materially from the listing/description — wrong color, size, model, features, materials, or specifications.
QD-03.key_evidence: Original product listing (cached/scraped), photos of received item, order confirmation details, merchant product specs page
QD-03.auto_fetch_sources: Product listing scraper/cache, order confirmation data, image comparison (CLIP), merchant catalog API

QD-04.name: Counterfeit / Inauthentic Goods
QD-04.description: Cardholder claims the received product is a counterfeit or replica when an authentic branded item was advertised and paid for.
QD-04.key_evidence: Photos showing authenticity markers (labels, serial numbers, packaging), brand verification, merchant sourcing documentation
QD-04.auto_fetch_sources: Brand authentication databases, image analysis for authenticity markers, merchant supplier documentation

QD-05.name: Wrong Item Sent
QD-05.description: Merchant shipped an entirely different product than what was ordered — e.g., ordered a laptop, received a tablet.
QD-05.key_evidence: Order confirmation vs. received item photos, packing slip, shipping label details, merchant inventory/pick records
QD-05.auto_fetch_sources: Order management system, warehouse pick records, product image comparison

QD-06.name: Quality Unacceptable / Below Standard
QD-06.description: Item matches the general description but quality is far below reasonable expectations — e.g., a '100% wool' sweater that pills immediately.
QD-06.key_evidence: Product listing claims, cardholder evidence of quality issues, industry standards for product type, merchant return policy, reviews
QD-06.auto_fetch_sources: Product listing data, review aggregation, industry quality standards databases

BA-01.name: Duplicate Charge
BA-01.description: Cardholder was charged two or more times for a single transaction/purchase.
BA-01.key_evidence: Transaction logs with timestamps, receipt/invoice for original charge, merchant POS/payment gateway logs
BA-01.auto_fetch_sources: Transaction history API, payment gateway duplicate detection, merchant POS records

BA-02.name: Incorrect Amount Charged
BA-02.description: The amount charged differs from the agreed price — overcharge, undercharge that was later 'corrected' without consent, or wrong currency conversion.
BA-02.key_evidence: Original receipt/quote/price listing, transaction amount, agreed price evidence, currency conversion records
BA-02.auto_fetch_sources: POS receipt data, merchant pricing database, currency exchange rate at transaction time

BA-03.name: Paid by Other Means
BA-03.description: Cardholder claims they paid for the same transaction using a different payment method (cash, another card, bank transfer) but were still charged on Amex.
BA-03.key_evidence: Alternative payment receipt/proof, merchant payment records across all channels, transaction reconciliation
BA-03.auto_fetch_sources: Merchant multi-channel payment records, bank transfer confirmations, POS multi-tender logs

BA-04.name: Credit/Refund Not Processed
BA-04.description: Merchant promised or issued a refund/credit, but it never appeared on the cardholder's statement.
BA-04.key_evidence: Refund promise evidence (email, chat, receipt), merchant refund processing records, time elapsed since promise, return tracking if applicable
BA-04.auto_fetch_sources: Merchant refund transaction logs, communication records, return shipment tracking

BA-05.name: Credit Posted as Charge
BA-05.description: A transaction that should have been processed as a credit/refund was incorrectly posted as a charge, effectively double-charging the cardholder.
BA-05.key_evidence: Merchant processing records, original refund authorization, payment gateway transaction type logs
BA-05.auto_fetch_sources: Payment gateway logs, merchant accounting records

BA-06.name: Charge Amount Exceeds Authorization
BA-06.description: The amount actually charged is higher than what the cardholder originally authorized (e.g., tip added incorrectly, hotel incidentals inflated).
BA-06.key_evidence: Original authorization amount, final charged amount, authorization logs, signed receipt if card-present
BA-06.auto_fetch_sources: Authorization records API, POS terminal logs, signed receipt images

BA-07.name: Installment Billing Dispute
BA-07.description: Cardholder disputes the number of installments, installment amount, or the fact that a purchase was converted to installments without consent.
BA-07.key_evidence: Installment agreement, original transaction terms, payment schedule, cardholder consent records
BA-07.auto_fetch_sources: Installment plan records, merchant ToS, payment schedule API

BA-08.name: Currency / Conversion Dispute
BA-08.description: Cardholder disputes the currency in which the transaction was processed or claims an unfavorable/unauthorized currency conversion was applied.
BA-08.key_evidence: Transaction currency vs. cardholder's home currency, DCC (Dynamic Currency Conversion) consent, exchange rate at time of purchase
BA-08.auto_fetch_sources: Currency exchange rate APIs, DCC records, POS currency selection logs

CR-01.name: Goods Returned but No Refund
CR-01.description: Cardholder returned merchandise per the merchant's return policy, but the refund was never processed.
CR-01.key_evidence: Return shipment tracking, delivery confirmation to merchant, merchant return policy, return authorization (RMA), communication about refund timeline
CR-01.auto_fetch_sources: Return shipment carrier tracking, merchant RMA system, refund processing logs
CR-01.section: D. CANCELLATION, RETURN & RECURRING BILLING ISSUES

CR-02.name: Goods/Services Cancelled but Still Charged
CR-02.description: Cardholder cancelled an order for goods or services before delivery/performance, but was still charged.
CR-02.key_evidence: Cancellation confirmation (email, order status), cancellation timestamp vs. charge timestamp, merchant cancellation policy, order status records
CR-02.auto_fetch_sources: Merchant order management system, cancellation confirmation emails, merchant cancellation policy
CR-02.section: D. CANCELLATION, RETURN & RECURRING BILLING ISSUES

CR-03.name: Cancelled Recurring / Subscription Billing
CR-03.description: Cardholder cancelled a recurring subscription or membership but continues to be charged in subsequent billing cycles.
CR-03.key_evidence: Cancellation confirmation, cancellation date vs. charge dates, merchant cancellation policy, account login activity post-cancellation, merchant ToS
CR-03.auto_fetch_sources: Merchant subscription management system, cancellation records, account activity logs, billing system records
CR-03.section: D. CANCELLATION, RETURN & RECURRING BILLING ISSUES

CR-04.name: Free Trial Converted to Paid Without Consent
CR-04.description: Cardholder signed up for a free trial that auto-converted to a paid subscription without adequate notice or explicit consent.
CR-04.key_evidence: Original trial sign-up terms, trial-to-paid notification evidence, opt-in/consent records, cardholder communication history
CR-04.auto_fetch_sources: Merchant trial conversion records, email notification logs, sign-up flow screenshots/ToS
CR-04.section: D. CANCELLATION, RETURN & RECURRING BILLING ISSUES

CR-05.name: Hotel No-Show / Cancelled Reservation
CR-05.description: Cardholder was charged a no-show fee or deposit for a hotel/car rental reservation they believe they cancelled in time, or the cancellation policy was unclear.
CR-05.key_evidence: Reservation confirmation, cancellation policy disclosed at booking, cancellation confirmation (if any), hotel/rental company records
CR-05.auto_fetch_sources: Hotel/rental booking system, cancellation policy records, communication logs
CR-05.section: D. CANCELLATION, RETURN & RECURRING BILLING ISSUES

CR-06.name: Goods Refused at Delivery
CR-06.description: Cardholder refused to accept delivery of goods (e.g., visibly damaged box, wrong item evident from outside), but was still charged.
CR-06.key_evidence: Carrier return-to-sender records, refusal notation on tracking, merchant receipt of returned goods
CR-06.auto_fetch_sources: Carrier tracking with refusal status, merchant receiving records
CR-06.section: D. CANCELLATION, RETURN & RECURRING BILLING ISSUES

AR-01.name: Unrecognized Charge (Not Fraud)
AR-01.description: Cardholder does not recognize a charge on their statement but it may be a legitimate purchase they forgot, a DBA name mismatch, or a family member's purchase. Distinct from fraud — the card was not stolen.
AR-01.key_evidence: Transaction details, merchant DBA name mapping, cardholder purchase history, device/IP data for online transactions
AR-01.auto_fetch_sources: Merchant DBA registry, transaction metadata, cardholder purchase history

AR-02.name: Authorization Not Obtained
AR-02.description: Transaction was processed without obtaining proper authorization from the issuer, or authorization was obtained but had expired before the charge was submitted.
AR-02.key_evidence: Authorization logs, authorization timestamp vs. submission timestamp, issuer authorization records
AR-02.auto_fetch_sources: Authorization network records, merchant POS authorization logs

AR-03.name: Transaction Not Recognized (Card-Present Dispute)
AR-03.description: Cardholder disputes a card-present transaction, claiming they were at the merchant's location but did not make this specific charge (e.g., different amount, tip added without consent).
AR-03.key_evidence: POS terminal records, signed receipt, EMV chip data, CCTV (if applicable), itemized receipt
AR-03.auto_fetch_sources: POS transaction logs, receipt images, EMV transaction certificates

SP-01.name: Vehicle Rental Damage/Theft/Loss
SP-01.description: Cardholder disputes charges related to alleged vehicle damage, theft, or loss-of-use fees from a car rental company.
SP-01.key_evidence: Rental agreement, vehicle inspection reports (before/after), photos of alleged damage, insurance coverage, damage repair estimates
SP-01.auto_fetch_sources: Rental company records, inspection photo comparison, insurance verification, repair shop estimates

SP-02.name: Hotel/Lodging Incidental Charges
SP-02.description: Cardholder disputes add-on charges from a hotel stay — minibar, pay-per-view, resort fees, room damage charges — claiming they are unauthorized or inflated.
SP-02.key_evidence: Itemized hotel folio, signed guest registration, hotel's incidental charge policy, room inspection records
SP-02.auto_fetch_sources: Hotel PMS (property management system), guest folio data, room inspection logs

SP-03.name: Airline / Travel Service Dispute
SP-03.description: Cardholder disputes charges related to flights (cancellation fees, baggage fees, seat upgrade charges, no-show fees) or travel services not rendered.
SP-03.key_evidence: Booking confirmation, airline cancellation policy, boarding records, baggage tracking, cardholder communication with airline
SP-03.auto_fetch_sources: Airline reservation system, boarding pass scan records, baggage tracking system

SP-04.name: Timeshare / Vacation Club Dispute
SP-04.description: Cardholder disputes charges from timeshare companies — maintenance fees, special assessments, misrepresented vacation packages, or denied cancellation within the rescission period.
SP-04.key_evidence: Timeshare contract, rescission period terms, maintenance fee schedule, cardholder cancellation attempts, marketing materials vs. actual offering
SP-04.auto_fetch_sources: Timeshare contract records, state rescission period laws, communication logs

SP-05.name: Insurance-Covered Charge
SP-05.description: Cardholder claims the charge should have been covered by insurance (travel insurance, health insurance, rental insurance) rather than billed to their card.
SP-05.key_evidence: Insurance policy details, claim filed with insurer, insurer response/denial, merchant billing records

SP-06.name: Introductory Offer / Promotional Terms Dispute
SP-06.description: Cardholder claims they were charged full price when a promotional/introductory rate should have applied, or that promotional terms were misrepresented.
SP-06.key_evidence: Promotional offer terms, sign-up confirmation, pricing at time of purchase, merchant promotional records
SP-06.auto_fetch_sources: Merchant promotional campaign records, sign-up flow data, pricing engine records

SP-07.name: Misrepresentation / False Advertising
SP-07.description: Cardholder claims the merchant misrepresented the terms of sale, used deceptive marketing, or engaged in bait-and-switch tactics.
SP-07.key_evidence: Marketing materials/ads at time of purchase, product listing, actual terms delivered, cardholder communication, merchant ToS
SP-07.auto_fetch_sources: Cached marketing pages (Wayback Machine), product listing snapshots, advertising campaign records

SP-08.name: ATM / Cash Dispensing Dispute
SP-08.description: Cardholder claims they did not receive cash (or received partial amount) from an ATM withdrawal that was charged to their card.
SP-08.key_evidence: ATM transaction logs, ATM camera footage, ATM reconciliation records, cash cassette balance
SP-08.auto_fetch_sources: ATM network records, ATM journal logs, surveillance system
